errors.ONBOARDING_PROJECT_NOT_ELIGIBLE: An onboarding can only be started for planned and active projects.
errors.ONBOARDING_FORM_EXISTS: This project already has a form. Reload the page.
errors.ONBOARDING_INVALID_TRANSITION: This status change is not possible.
errors.ONBOARDING_NOT_EDITABLE: The structure is fixed by now and can no longer be changed.
errors.ONBOARDING_REVIEW_INCOMPLETE: No block has a question for the customer.
errors.ONBOARDING_CALL_DATE_REQUIRED: The date of the onboarding call is missing.
errors.ONBOARDING_RELEASE_WARNINGS: There are notes to check before the release. Review them and confirm the release.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: The input is incomplete or invalid.
errors.INTERNAL: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

project.title: Onboarding

empty.title: No onboarding started yet
empty.description: The onboarding collects every detail and file for this project before the work begins. You pick a template and adjust the form to this project.
empty.readOnlyDescription: The onboarding lets the team collect every detail and file for this project before the work begins. None has been started for this project yet.

project.notEligible: An onboarding can only be started for planned and active projects.
project.draftHint: The form is a draft. The customer cannot see it yet.
project.progressNone: The form has no required fields yet.

dialog.title: Start onboarding
dialog.description: This creates a draft with its own copies of the blocks. You adjust it for this project afterwards; the customer cannot see it yet.
dialog.templateHint: Later changes to the template do not affect this form.
dialog.blankHint: The form starts without blocks. You add them from the catalog or create your own.
dialog.noTemplates: There is no active template yet. You can start empty and add blocks in the form.
dialog.prefillHint: Company-wide answers are taken over from this customer's last completed onboarding.

release.released: The form is released. The customer can now fill it in in the portal.

dialog.title: Release this form?
dialog.description: The customer then sees the form in the portal and can fill it in. You can keep changing its structure until they submit.

warnings.missing_translation: “{block}” lacks some texts in {language}. Contacts with that language see the block in another language.
warnings.no_portal_access: The customer has no portal access yet. Nobody can open the form until you invite a contact.

dialog.notReleasable: The form does not ask anything yet. It needs at least one block, every block at least one field and every group at least one sub-field.
dialog.conflict: Someone changed the form in the meantime. The current version is loaded. Check it, then release.

answers.empty: This form has no blocks yet. Once it has, the answers of the customer appear here.
answers.servicesChanged: The project services were changed after the customer confirmed them. Clear that up with them before you complete the onboarding.

progress.label: {answered} of {total} required answers given
progress.none: The form has no required answers.

blocks.empty: This form has no blocks yet. Add some from the catalog or create your own.

picker.title: Add a block from the catalog
picker.description: The form gets its own copy. Only active blocks that are not in the form yet.
picker.empty: Every active block is already in the form.

ownDialog.title: Own block
ownDialog.description: This block exists only in this form. You add fields and further languages afterwards.

hints.key: Internal name of lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Suggested from the title.

removeDialog.title: Remove block?
removeDialog.description: “{name}” is removed from this form with all its fields and answers. Attached files stay in the customer's file area.

fieldDeleteDialog.title: Delete field?
fieldDeleteDialog.descriptionGroup: “{name}” is deleted from this form with all its sub-fields.
fieldDeleteDialog.usageNone: This field has no answers and no files yet.
fieldDeleteDialog.usage: This affects {answers} and {files}. The answers are lost. The files stay in the customer's file area; only their link to the form is removed.
fieldDeleteDialog.usageFailed: The number of affected answers could not be loaded. Existing answers to this field are lost when you delete it.

editor.heading: Edit block
editor.select: Pick a block from the list to edit its texts and fields.
editor.locked: After the submission the structure is fixed. Request what is missing in the review.
editor.released: The form is released. The customer sees every change to its structure at once.
editor.readOnly: You can view this form but not change it.
editor.conflict: Someone has changed the form in the meantime. The current state is loaded, please repeat your change.

notSubmitted.title: Nothing to review yet
notSubmitted.description: The review starts once the customer has submitted the form. Then you go through it block by block: complete or question.

states.changesRequested: The change request is with the customer. The review is locked until they submit again.
states.completed: The onboarding is completed. The review stays here as a record.
states.readOnly: You can view the review but not change it.

modeHint.customer: The customer reads the question in the portal and can edit this block again once you send the change request.
modeHint.call: The question goes on the agenda for the onboarding call. The customer does not see it.

controls.modeLegend: How do we clear this up?
controls.noteRequired: Write what is missing or unclear.
controls.noteTooLong: The question can have at most {max} characters.
controls.conflict: Someone has reviewed this block in the meantime. The current state is loaded.

blocks.heading: Blocks in the order of the form

request.hint: You can send once at least one block has a question for the customer.
request.sent: The change request is sent. The customer can now complete the blocks in the portal.

dialog.title: Send change request?
dialog.description: The customer gets a chat message and can edit only these blocks again. The review is locked until they submit again.
dialog.listHeading: These questions go to the customer
dialog.conflict: Someone has changed the form in the meantime. The current state is loaded. Check the list, then send.

agenda.title: Agenda for the onboarding call
agenda.empty: No items yet. Questions you want to clarify in the call end up here.
agenda.servicesChanged: Services were changed after the customer confirmed them
agenda.copyFailed: Copying did not work. Select the items and copy them by hand.
